- `pattern_fit`: `injection_only` — the published fix touches one function in one library file, and every engine route (rootfs, overlay, bind data image) funnels through the single `AuthorizedPath` call.
- Strongest lever: the documented exception "only effective in setuid mode… ignored for the root user" (`pkg/util/singularityconf/config.go:333-334`) makes the `--oci` / `oci run` routes defensibly dismissible, while the must-keep "limit path is exactly the image file" case traps an over-broad separator-append fix.
- Biggest red flag: `single_site` (no O2 site, no O8 route in scope; also `j_multi_site`=0).
